test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A student has to obtain a minimum of 50% marks in an examination to pass. He scored 40% and failed by 30 marks. Find the total marks of the examination.
solution:
**Given:**

A student has to obtain a minimum of 50% marks in an examination to pass.

He scored 40% and failed by 30 marks. 

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

50% - 40% = 30

⇒ 10% = 30

⇒ 1% = 3

⇒ 100% = 300

So, the total numbers = 300

**∴ The total marks of the examination are 300.**
